text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...A placed finish. It is a wonderful 
result.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However, I...
(Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash, that was an incredible run.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No, seriously... you were so cool, I was 
totally mesmerized...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Lady Flash...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Is she looking at me...?
(Waaaaaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... Thank you so much for your 
support.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Next time, I'll show you a victory. 
Without fail...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I still haven't come down from 
the excitement... I'll calm down shortly.
choice_data_list: That was an incredible race, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Both the spectators and the 
Umamusume were showing far more enthusiasm 
than usual.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"That is why even I cannot suppress my 
emotions... Though it is hardly proper 
behavior."
choice_data_list: So you're frustrated about losing, huh.
It means you're frustrated that you lost.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...However, greed starts to creep in.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I need to get my emotions in 
order—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I want to win. I find myself feeling 
that... nothing less than that will ever 
satisfy me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Do you think so? Even just placing is 
undoubtedly a wonderful result."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's why placing on the board was 
my goal. However, now...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's move on to our next topic 
right away.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Heading into the final leg of the Classic 
Triple Crown races—the Kikuka-sho.
choice_data_list:
Shall we head back to the waiting room 
then?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes—!

When I returned to the waiting room, there 
was a message waiting from Eishin Flash's 
parents.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"‘Your hard work came through loud and 
clear. Placing on the board is a wonderful 
result.’"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"‘It's proof that you've truly grown 
stronger. That's precisely why losing felt 
so frustrating, I'm sure.’"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“...... 'To be honest, I want to embrace 
you and comfort you.'”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"May the splendid joy of victory fill you 
in all the days to come."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...My parents have no plans to visit 
Japan during these three years.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I want to bring you lots of victory 
reports, at the very least.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We've achieved the expected results up to 
this point. Let's continue on track just 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Before that, there's one thing I'd 
like to mention. I don't think it's a big 
deal, but actually—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I still cannot accept this. —Why are you 
taking the Kikuka Sho off our goals?

After the race, I had a doctor examine 
Eishin Flash following her report of 
discomfort in her legs... It seemed to be 
accumulated muscular fatigue.
choice_data_list:
If you don't rest, the pain will only get 
worse.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...However, a full recovery by the Kikuka 
Sho is entirely possible."
choice_data_list:
Of course, if you feel up to it, let's 
enter.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I don't understand that. You set a 
goal, and plan your schedule toward it. 
Shouldn't that be more than enough to 
handle it?
choice_data_list:
Can you promise you won't push yourself 
too hard?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka-sho is such a punishing race 
that they say only the strongest Umamusume 
can win it, requiring immense innate 
stamina. With our current schedule, 
fatigue will only continue to build.
choice_data_list:
Your goal was to "run your race to the 
end," right?

Your goal was to "run your race to the 
end," wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ... However—

"Adjusting the schedule depending on my 
judgment."

"Adjust the schedule depending on my 
judgment."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
............ A promise is a promise, no 
matter what...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I will remove... the Kikuka 
Sho from my goals.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Running the race through to the end is 
what's most important, after all...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...... I'm fine. Excuse me, I'll be going 
now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My perfect schedule is—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
After consulting with my father and 
mother—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...There's no way I could say it. The 
breakdown was caused by my poor 
management...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Because it's all due to my own 
shortcomings—
